supported_claim: In the current deterministic V-Tile simulator, RF-bank pressure can halve issue throughput on a high-reuse synthetic FP32 workload, while a small operand cache largely removes that modeled bottleneck; the same cache does not rescue a dependent long-latency memory workload.
claim_boundary: Synthetic simulator evidence only. No physical frequency, area, power, energy, real-workload performance, commercial-GPU superiority, or RTX 5090 equivalence is established.
